data.one_liner: A date and time picker widget for Flutter supporting multiple languages and custom pickers.
data.what_it_does: Allows users to select dates, times, or combined date-time values through a customizable picker interface. It supports multiple languages and provides options to define custom picker models.
use_when: You need a customizable date and time picker in your Flutter application.
You require multi-language support for date-time picking out-of-the-box.
avoid_when: You prefer using standard Material or Cupertino date pickers provided directly by Flutter's core framework.
You do not need customization or internationalization beyond standard defaults.
strengths: Supports a wide variety of languages and locales.
Allows custom picker models via CommonPickerModel extension.
weaknesses: Forked from an inactive package repository.
Imperative function call style rather than a standard Flutter form field widget.
